restaurant.name: Fast Food Restaurant
restaurant.notice: All meats are 100% Halal and flame-cooked to order.

favorites.name: Chef's Favorites
favorites.description: Our most celebrated house specialties, flame-grilled and loved by our regular guests.

categories.name: Signature Burgers
categories.description: Double-smashed prime beef patties seared on cast iron, served on freshly baked artisanal brioche buns.

items.name: The Black Truffle Smash
items.description: Double smash prime beef, roasted garlic & black truffle aioli, melted aged English cheddar, caramelized shallots, peppery wild baby arugula.

items.name: Smoked Beef Bacon & BBQ
items.description: Twin smash beef patties, crispy wood-smoked beef bacon, hickory BBQ glaze, melted pepper jack, golden tobacco onions.

items.name: Heritage Classic Deluxe
items.description: Double Angus beef patties, yellow cheddar, crisp heirloom beefsteak tomato, shredded iceberg lettuce, house dill pickles, secret bistro sauce.

items.name: Hot Fermented Honey Crispy Chicken
items.description: 24-hour buttermilk brined crispy fried chicken thigh, fermented habanero hot honey drizzle, crunchy pickled jalapeño slaw, kewpie mayo.

items.name: Wagyu & Wild Forest Mushroom
items.description: Dry-aged Wagyu beef blend, pan-roasted wild chanterelles & shiitake, cave-aged Gruyère cheese, black garlic reduction.

categories.name: Gourmet Rolls & Wraps
categories.description: Freshly stretched flatbreads rolled warm with charred spiced proteins, fresh herbs, and house-churned sauces.

items.name: Slow-Braised Lamb & Smoked Tahini
items.description: 12-hour pulled tender lamb shoulder, fire-scorched eggplant baba ganoush, minted sheep yogurt, roasted pine nuts, pomegranate molasses.

items.name: Crispy Halloumi & Wild Za'atar
items.description: Golden griddled Halloumi cheese, crushed Hass avocado, heirloom confit tomatoes, wild Lebanese za'atar herbs, cold-pressed olive oil.

items.name: Blackened Fish & Chipotle Crema Wrap
items.description: Spiced grilled red snapper fillet, charred lime crema, pickled red onion, shredded purple cabbage crunch, fresh cilantro in warm tortilla.

categories.name: Flame-Grilled BBQ
categories.description: Slow-smoked over seasoned oak wood and finished over searing open charcoal for an authentic smoky crust.

items.name: Smoked Prime Beef Brisket
items.description: Generous cut prime beef brisket smoked for 14 hours, deep peppery bark, melting smoke ring, sour dill pickles, warm buttered skillet cornbread.

items.name: Flame-Seared Lamb Chops
items.description: Tender pasture-raised lamb chops marinated in rosemary and smoked garlic, charred on open flame, served with mint chimichurri.

items.name: Charcoal Grilled Atlantic Salmon
items.description: Wild Atlantic salmon fillet basted with brown sugar glaze, charred lemon cheek, blistered cherry tomatoes, dill crème fraîche.

items.name: Smoked Beef Brisket Burnt Ends
items.description: Caramelized beef brisket point cubes rendered with oak wood smoke, tossed in tangy espresso BBQ reduction and toasted sesame.
